value.rationale: The even balanced model leaves a natural mathematical gap: does an unchanged uniformly coupled network support two-camp oscillation with unequal camp populations, including odd population sizes? The theorem shows a sharp absolute compositional obstruction (both camps >1/3) together with an exact rate window; linearizing only the two-block subsystem would miss the obstruction. A minimal exact five-agent witness demonstrates feasibility, while the neutral translation is carefully classified. This is a structural stability theorem, not an arbitrary small parameter perturbation or a known-table recomputation.
